name: Configuration Change
description: Modify environment variables, feature flags, CI/CD configuration, or deployment parameters.

default_promises.description: Critical path works with new config
Rollback to previous config is possible

clarifying_questions.question: Is this a secret or credential change?

example_contract:
CONTRACT: CTR-CONFIG01
  TYPE: CONFIG:ENV_ADD
  SCOPE: .env.example, config.ts
  MODULES: config
  RISK CAP: HIGH
  PROMISES:
    1. App starts → verify: compiles
    2. Critical path works → verify: test_passes
    3. Rollback possible → verify: diff_inspection
  STATUS: proposed
